unit.title: Topical authority comes from comprehensive cluster coverage

claim.text: The source states Google does not evaluate a page in isolation; covering the full journey of a topic cluster builds topical authority and makes ranking for every keyword in that cluster easier, including competitive ones.
claim.quote: Google doesn't evaluate your page in isolation. See, when someone searches how to prevent ransomware attacks, Google checks whether your site also covers things like what is ransomware, signs that your network has been compromised, ransomware, incident response checklist. All of those live in the same funnel. They're the same person at different stages of the same problem. So, if your site covers that full journey, Google trusts you more on the whole subject. Now, this is what SEOs call topical authority. The more comprehensively you cover a topic cluster, the easier it becomes to rank for every keyword in that cluster, including the very competitive ones.

unknowns: Source does not define how to measure comprehensive coverage beyond the topic cluster.
